tenderSchedule.title: Dismantling of old chain link fencing and providing compound wall allround KPCL quarters at BHEP colony- Phase IV
tenderSchedule.description: Replacement of damaged chain-link fencing with construction of a compound wall with barbed wire on top along the boundary of Bhadra Colony for a balance length of 410m.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer CIVIL Office SVP Kargal

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
DECLARATIONS The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the last date of submission of bid.
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere (GoK circular DATED :07.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, prevailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills. A. penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment(AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology. B. penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust.

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection.

The successful bidder shall make payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Government of Karnataka from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him.
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful bidder shall furnish Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India and enter into an agreement within 20 days of receipt of Letter of Intent through e-portal.
Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) shall be equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount and should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period.

Work completion period is 4 (Four) months excluding monsoon. Defect liability period for the work is Twelve Months(12 months) from the date of completion of the work. Contract period is Sixteen Months (16 months) (i.e Work completion period plus Defect liability period).
If tenderer has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practice, action shall be initiated finance department, Government of Karnataka Notification No.FD884 Exp-12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Civil)Kargal, during office hours. Mobile- 9449598823.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least One Civil Construction work of value not less than Rs. 21.00 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the Work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking from the officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

The intending bidder should have achieved in at least Two (02) financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs. 42.00 Lakhs in the last 05 (Five) financial years i.e. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). Turnover certificate, duly certified by chartered Accountant (along with UDIN No) shall be furnished. (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

technicalCriterionList.description: Assessed available tender capacity is (AxNx2.5-B). Where, A is Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited for 0.33 year. B is Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.33 year (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Dismantling of old chain link fencing and providing compound wall allround KPCL quarters at BHEP colony- Phase IV

itemList.description: Dismantling of barbed wire fencing/ wire mesh fencing including posts, foundation concrete, back filling of pit by manual means including disposal of dismantled material with all lifts and lead, stacking serviceable material and unserviceable material separately.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications,including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights,including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work-In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

Providing and laying in position cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. mix 1:4:8 using 40mm nominal size graded crushed course aggregate.
Providing Coursed rubble masonry (first sort) with hard stone in foundation and plinth with Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand).

Providing and laying in position cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6. Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.

Providing Brick work with common burnt clay Non Modular bricks of class designation 3.5 in superstructure above plinth level in all shapes and sizes in Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand) including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and usage charges of machinery & other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work.

Providing 18 mm cement plaster in two coats under layer 12 mm thick cement plaster with cement mortar 1:5 (1 cement : 5 coarse sand) and a top layer 6 mm thick cement plaster with cement mortar 1:3 (1 cement: 3 coarse sand) finished rough with sponge to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less than 50 gm/litre and UV resistance as per IS 15489:2004, Alkali & fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint of required shade (Company Depot Tinted) with silicon additives, New work(Two coats applied @ 1.43 litre/ 10 m². Over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 0.90 litre/10 m² with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing Steel work welded in built up sections/ framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer using structural steel etc. as required. In gratings, frames, guard bar, ladder, railings, brackets, gates and similar works including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Fencing with G.I. barbed wire Angle iron post placed at required distance embedded in cement concrete blocks, every 15th post, last but one end post and corner post shall be strutted on both sides and end post on one side only and provided with horizontal lines and two diagonals interwoven with horizontal wires, of barbed wire weighing 9.38 kg per 100 m (minimum), between the two posts fitted and fixed with G.I.staples, turn buckles etc. complete. (Cost of posts, struts, earth work and concrete work to be paid for separately). Payment to be made per metre cost of total length of barbed wire used.

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
